    Reflecting distinguished triangles #

    Let Γ : 𝒯 ⥤ 𝒮 be a triangulated functor and P a class of objects of 𝒯 which is stable under ⟦1⟧ and contains a cone of every morphism between its objects. If Γ is bijective on morphisms between objects of P, then a triangle with vertices in P is distinguished as soon as its image under Γ is: complete its first morphism to a distinguished triangle with third vertex in P, compare the images under Γ, and lift the comparison isomorphism.

    theorem ExtriangulatedRealization.exists_iso_of_distinguished {𝒯 : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_1} 𝒯] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive 𝒯] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject 𝒯] [CategoryTheory.HasShift 𝒯 ℤ] [∀ (n : ℤ), (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor 𝒯 n).Additive] [CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated 𝒯] {A B B' C : 𝒯} {x : A ⟶ B} {y : B ⟶ C} {x' : A ⟶ B'} {y' : B' ⟶ C} {z : C ⟶ A⟦1⟧} (h : CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk x y z ∈ CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles) (h' : CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk x' y' z ∈ CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles) :
    ∃ (e : B ≅ B'), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp x e.hom = x' ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e.hom y' = y

    Two distinguished triangles with the same end terms and the same third morphism have isomorphic middle terms, compatibly with the first two morphisms.
